entry_rule: SHORT t+1; Lower=min(previous completed Close, previous ExpectedLow); Open<=Lower; enter only after price reclaims Lower+1.0
cost_stress_limit_note: All three splits positive through 2 points/trade; OOS1 negative at 3 points/trade
anti_bias: decision uses only frozen SHORT t+1, prior completed Close/ExpectedLow, current Open and live reclaim; no T High/Low/Close look-ahead
source_note: Metrics supplied by user from completed full-period backtest; package activates the audited rule but does not independently reproduce the absent source result files.
